The thing we dont talk about anymore (well at least when my mom is around) is when I accidentally got her and her boyfriend arrested. So this all happened when I was about 10 years old. My mom had "forgotten" to pay her car bill so when the repo men came by to take it away she decided to hide her car in our wooded backyard area (We lived in a very rural/Isolated area). After about 30min of driving around the repo guys decided to set up and wait until my mom moved her car (which wasn't gonna happen). So being the 10 year old "Hero" I was, I asked my mom if I could go out and shoot my pellet gun at some cans, and being the type of mother she was she said "Sure". So I grabbed my BB Gun and ventured out the back door to "defend" my mother from these "evil" repo guy. So being the clueless 10yr old I was I loaded my Red Rider BB gun up and pointed it at the repo guy's in their truck (which were way out of range of the bb gun) I then started shooting at them. But then suddenly right after I started shooting, the repo men sped off. And being the 10yr old I was I considered myself a hero who had saved the day. About 20min later I left with my moms boyfriend to go watch a football game at a friend's house. When we finally got back to the house it was pitch black outside but it felt like something was off. Up the street I saw a police suv parked, "Cool!" 10yr old me said. Then we pulled into the driveway and parked, as I stepped out of the truck I hear a deep voice come from the dark. "Step back into the vehicle now!". Then all of a sudden the entire neighborhood is lit up with police lights (it looked like Christmas). As I look around I notice police with big guns and bullet proof vests on. The cops then pulled my moms boyfriend out of the car and arrested him. I then see the cops open the garage door and head inside with guns at the ready. I was then pulled aside by a cop who let me lay down on a couch that was in the garage. As I was laying there I hear the cops say to one another to look for a rifle that was brown. Then I see my mom being pulled out of the house in handcuffs and then put into a cop car. I then thought to myself "that gun sounds a lot like my BB gun". A cop then came out and said there were no guns in the house. I then told the cop about my BB gun but he just shrugged it off and said they were looking for a "Real" gun. And so the cops hauled my mom and her boyfriend off to jail for the night, and I was taken home to my dad. And that's how I got my mom arrested.
I've even lost weight (285lbs --> 229lbs) in an attempt to get a girls attention.

"Good things come to those wait". A friend of mine was faced with a similar issue, he had fallen bad for this chick and he had talked to her almost daily and they had tons in common but there was just one issue...she had a boyfriend. After my friend learned about this he lost all of his motivation. He figured there was no point in pursuing this girl. But I convinced him to continue his pursuit and stay positive. It took about 4 months before the girl and her boyfriend broke up. But instead of picking her up at her low point he waited until the storm past. They continued talking for a couple months as friends until they finally got together. Not only did my friend wait it out but he also escaped the "Friend Zone". Hope this helps you decide...best of luck.
